comparison.objective: Remove unloaded lines from a pin rail while preserving load-bearing lines; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Load-state discrimination and lifting flexible eyes from pins versus rigid tool alignment, rotary adjustment, locking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Free lines crated and taut lines untouched versus two safe stops and measured setting retention.
comparison.reason: Different physical mechanism and tested judgment. No spec versions or numeric load/placement thresholds were provided.
